text.en:
Section forty-five of Act Numbered Four thousand and seven of the Philippine Legislature is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 45. This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-three: Provided, That the
Governor-General is hereby authorized to postpone the effectivity of the provisions contained in the second
and third paragraphs of section twelve not later than June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and thirty-four."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 12, 1933.
